description: Revert to the proven stable 8-layer architecture and increase the global batch size to 2^19 with a higher Muon LR (0.033) to maximize gradient steps and training stability, as the 10-layer model failed to converge sufficiently within the 5-minute budget despite higher capacity, and the 8-layer configuration consistently yields robust performance around 0.991 BPB, suggesting the 0.9818 result may have been an outlier or insufficiently converged.
